entries.title: Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with PC capture/settings flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it launched alongside the console versions, has the same game content, and gives the most flexible capture/settings path. Xbox has 60 fps and Smart Delivery support, but that does not outweigh PC capture and tuning flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel on Steam and play the Windows PC build; check for any display or performance notes before capture.
